For the best self-heating lithium battery, I recommend looking at LiFePO4 (lithium iron phosphate) batteries with built-in low-temperature heating.

These are particularly useful for RVs, off-grid solar systems, boats, and installations in freezing climates.

The most important features are automatic heating below freezing, low-temperature charging protection, a reliable battery management system (BMS), and good warranty support.

My recommendation

For a typical 12V 100Ah installation, I'd choose Epoch for long-term ownership or LiTime for value. For larger 200–300Ah systems, the ranking may change.

One important detail: self-heating does not necessarily mean the battery heats itself continuously. Some models require incoming charging current to activate their heaters.
